title: State Lean array facts and ite gates over folded definitions
summary: With arrays, the Lean reconstructor now states array facts and ite gates over shared term and formula definitions, reverting them around each lemma's unfold, instead of writing every nested term out in full. A depth-8 nested-ite array instance drops from 57 MB of uncheckable Lean to 0.74 MB that Lean accepts.
